root_idea.summary: The root centers on the cutting off or absence of hope, hence despair and the loss of expectation.
root_idea.development: The semantic range develops from cessation of hope to despairing states and causative or derived forms. A secondary Quranic usage of the Form I verb is reported as “to know,” explained either as a dialectal or figurative usage or as knowledge inferred from the certainty underlying despair.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Form I verb is a distinct Quran-attested lexical form.
The Quran-attested Form X verb is presented under its normalized Classical Arabic citation form.
The Quran-attested intensive nominal is presented as its own lexical form.

senses.definition: To despair of something; to lose or cut off hope concerning it.
senses.usage_conditions: Commonly construed with مِنْ for the person or matter concerning which hope is abandoned. This is the ordinary Quranic sense of the verb.

senses.definition: To know or recognize, in the Quranic expression associated with أَفَلَمْ يَيْأَسِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا.
senses.usage_conditions: A reported dialectal or figurative usage, and in this Quranic construction also explained as knowledge inferred from the believers’ despair that the matter could be otherwise; it is not the ordinary meaning of the verb.

senses.definition: To despair; to give up hope.
senses.usage_conditions: Form X expressing the experience or attainment of a state in which hope has been abandoned, including despair concerning someone or something.

senses.definition: Intensely or habitually despairing; strongly given to despair.
senses.usage_conditions: An intensive adjectival expression for a pronounced or recurrent state of despair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to despair; to cut off his hope.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV causative, commonly construed with مِنْ for the thing concerning which hope is cut off.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause a woman to become barren.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized causative use, attested in the expression أَيْأَسَهَا اللهُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman, to become barren.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use of the Form I verb with a woman as subject.
A disease name in Classical Arabic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Despairing; one who has lost hope.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The ordinary active-participial adjective, distinct from the intensive form يَؤُوسٌ.
Feminine adjective or noun in the specialized barren-woman usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Despaired of; regarded as beyond hope.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Passive participial construction with مِنْهُ identifying the person or thing regarded as hopeless.

cautions: The interpretation of the Quranic Form I expression at 13:31 as “know” is a reported dialectal, figurative, or inferential usage and should not be generalized as the ordinary meaning of يَئِسَ.
